faq.q: How will I receive my tickets after a successful payment?
faq.a: Your electronic tickets (QR Codes) will be automatically sent to your registered email address and phone number (via Zalo/SMS) within 1–3 minutes after the payment is confirmed.

faq.q: Can I exchange or get a refund for purchased tickets?
faq.a: Exchange and refund policies depend on the individual regulations of each tourist attraction. Please carefully check the "Ticket Conditions" before payment or contact our hotline for assistance.

faq.q: Do agents have to commit to a monthly sales target?
faq.a: We offer various agent tiers, from independent affiliates with no sales targets to Diamond-level agents. Submit your information through the registration form, and our team will recommend a suitable package.
